title: krn pr ship refuses a body without Why, Verified and a Ticket/Refs line
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19. #1521 merged with a body holding only the attribution line: `krn pr body --refs t-wmdgs04` exited 64 (--refs is boolean) and ship read the body file as opaque text (src/ci/ship.ts:175-186, :489-492). Of the last 40 merged PRs, 18 lack `## Why` or `## Verified` (list in .krn/tmp/merged-prs.json analysis: 1504 1506 1507 1508 1512 1514 1516 1517 1519 plus old-template ones); 1508 has no Ticket/Refs line. No CI step lints the PR body (.github/workflows/ci.yml only reads Weakens-tests).
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
Outcome: `krn pr ship` refuses before any push, with exit 65 naming the missing parts, a body file lacking `## Why`, `## Verified` or a `Ticket:`/`Refs:` line; the PR-body check also runs in CI on PR_BODY so a body edited outside ship is caught.
Proof: `node --test test/ci/ship.test.ts: pass` with a near-empty body refused (exit 65, no push) and a `krn pr body` output accepted.
